items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Say you listen to Miff or Lou McGarry or Tea Garden.

ctx.x: That's a God gift. Anybody that's ever heard you say that. Would you advise young kids, if they have a lot of talent, not to bother to read? Just pick it up and use their...

Well, no. I advise them to take... Get the fundamentals of the horn. Learn the fundamentals through music. And then, after they learn the horn, know the notes. They can listen to records. And listen to those ideas and try to improve the ideas. Be original. Don't imitate them. But listen to those. Say you listen to Miff or Lou McGarry or Tea Garden. If you want to be a tea garden, you listen to tea garden records. And then you try to take what Jack's doing and do it a little better. That's what Ted Lewis always…
Great schooling for talking to an audience. Would you credit Ted Lewis with being the inspiration for your showmanship? That's right. Because everybody knows.
